name: ThirdShotHub Dink Hoodie
description: The ThirdShotHub Dink Hoodie is a warm-up layer cut for a paddle swing. The raglan sleeve and a gusseted underarm panel keep the hem from riding up on an overhead, and the hood is unlined so it packs flat into a paddle bag instead of bulking out the main compartment. Fabric is a midweight cotton-poly fleece that holds shape through repeated wash cycles.

specifications.fit: Athletic, raglan sleeve with gusseted underarm
specifications.pockets: Single kangaroo pocket with internal key loop

care_instructions: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle, inside out, with like colors. Tumble dry low or hang dry — high heat will shrink the cotton fraction and pull the raglan seam out of line. Do not iron the printed chest mark directly; press from the inside with a cloth between the iron and the fabric. No fabric softener, which coats the fleece and reduces its breathability.
